subject.title: feat(secrets): expose degraded owners to operators

question: Should `secrets.degraded[]` become the canonical additive operator status contract while `degradedSecretOwners` remains temporarily available for compatibility?
rationale: The PR creates a public RPC model consumed by generated clients and establishes a parallel representation; implementation correctness cannot determine the permanent protocol shape, authorized scope, or legacy-field lifetime.

options.title: Approve nested contract
options.body: Adopt `secrets.degraded[]`, confirm its operator authorization boundary, and retain the legacy field for a named compatibility window.

options.title: Extend legacy contract
options.body: Evolve the existing flat owner field instead of maintaining two public representations.

options.title: Keep inventory internal
options.body: Limit the richer inventory to logs and doctor until maintainers define the long-term RPC contract.

recommendation.title: Approve nested contract
recommendation.body: Adopt `secrets.degraded[]`, confirm its operator authorization boundary, and retain the legacy field for a named compatibility window.

likelyOwner.reason: This team is the identified owner for the combined secret-runtime, redaction, authorization, and protocol decision.
